stories.title: In West Bank's crumbling economy, some Palestinians turn to Israeli settlements to work
stories.summary: Amid record-setting attacks by settlers, Palestinian workers in the West Bank try to balance their need to earn a living working for Israeli factories and their anger towards the occupation.

stories.title: K-pop's global wave inspires Chile's next pop stars
stories.summary: K-pop has conquered the world. Now, Chile's young creatives are remixing the movement and making it their own.

stories.title: What immigration enforcement looks like when police are deputized to do ICE work
stories.summary: A sheriff in the Florida panhandle has gone all in on federal immigration enforcement. The state rewarded his department with almost $9 million in incentives.

stories.title: Months after being evacuated from Bahrain, military families await their next move
stories.summary: Sailors and family members who were evacuated from U.S. bases in the Middle East months ago are waiting for the military to figure out what will happen to the lives they left behind.

stories.title: She isn't just sewing a dress. She's growing one
stories.summary: In an age of fast fashion, author Eve Schaub wanted to go back to basics by growing a dress in her backyard. She's been working on her linen dress for over a year and still has a ways to go.

stories.title: The commercialization of the West African coast's slavery heritage
stories.summary: Along West Africa's slave coast, a painful past is being preserved — and marketed — raising questions about memory, tourism, and profit.
